asr.full_text: Welcome to Dell Tech Support! When you get a blue screen error – also known as a window stop error – it's good to know what information you need to help with the resolution. Here are 7 things to make a note of before you start troubleshooting. To help recover from a blue screen of death crash, ask the following questions. 1. When was the first time the error appeared? Was it a month ago? Two weeks? Two Days? 2. When does it usually happen? Does it happen while playing games, watching a movie, or when you're doing something else specific? Number 3 How often does it occur? Does it happen every 30 minutes, or every three days? Number 4 Have there been any recent changes? Can you think of any new hardware or software changes done to your computer? There is also some important information that you need to collect from the blue screen error screen itself. Number one, Which file is associated with the error? Number two, What is the name of the error? Number three, what is the error code? If the blue screen does not contain all this information, or if you can't recall all the details, just gather any of the information that you can. To help with gathering Stop Error information, you can't recall all the details, just gather any of the information that you can. To help with gathering stop error information, you can disable your PC's Auto Restart function. This will freeze the blue screen giving you time to make notes, but then you have to manually restart your computer afterwards. To do this, in the search box, type control panel and select System. Click on Advanced System settings, and under the Advanced tab, look for Startup and Recovery. Click on Settings, and disable Automatically Restart. Then, click Ok. If you want to look up the Blue Screen of death error code yourself, Microsoft has a list available on their website. The link is provided in the description below. Support Assist can also help with Blue Screen errors. Launch Support Assist, click on Hardware Checkup, and select Advanced Troubleshooting. Navigate to the Blue Screen Troubleshooter to find recent Blue Screen Events and see which troubleshooting steps are recommended. Watch our video on how to analyze Blue Screen Errors for more information. If you need to download SupportAssist, check out the link in the description. So if ever you get a Blue Screen screen, stop error contact us through social media on Facebook or Twitter and a tech support specialist will be happy to assist you troubleshoot. Check out our other helpful tips and tutorials on this channel. And if you liked this video, give it a like, and don't forget to subscribe. Thanks for watching!
